run_evaluation: run the evaluation script to compute PSNR, SSIM, and perceptual similarity metrics on a trained model
run_psnr_mask: run the psnr_mask function to compute masked PSNR between output and sampled images
run_ssim_mask: run the ssim_mask function to compute masked SSIM between output and sampled images
run_perceptual_sim_mask: run the perceptual_sim_mask function to compute masked perceptual similarity using a VGG16 network
run_check_initial_batch: run the check_initial_batch function to validate camera parameters match cached evaluation values
